denominator_policy.source_native_first: Retain the exact source denominator and its incomplete/terminal categories; never silently turn an incomplete into source false or source true.
denominator_policy.fixed_cohort_roles: For endpoint/rescue cohorts, all predeclared eligible initial environments remain in denominator. No credit or incomplete observation yields zero numerator; missing evidence remains unknown, not success. E3 normal recipe12 is not eligible rescue.
denominator_policy.event_roles: E2 denominator is every sampled complete signed2pi event, including term/timeout-at-complete false events. W35 denominator is every natural complete nonterminal command interval; partial/reset/window-ended/start-unobserved segments are outside this conditional denominator and MUST be reported separately.
denominator_policy.anti_survivor_outer_summary: If a NEW USER all-started-cohort lower bound is wanted, preregister exposure/attempt units before any policy outcome. Report success/(success+source_false+incomplete+unknown) with mutually exclusive outcome bins only, separately labelled conservative attempt credit, never call it the original complete-event rate. Do not count zero-control rows as attempts, double count split segments, or infer missing attempts from environment-controls.
denominator_policy.coverage_gate: No final 90 assertion from conditional event rates alone with unknown/missing exposure. Source-unit ledger + group exposures + censored fractions are required. New aggregation status is not original historical graduation.
denominator_policy.missing_group: No exposure or absent predicate is pending, not 0/0=100%; group denominator may be 0 but rate is null.
denominator_policy.ordinary_vs_truncation: Ordinary/integrity reasons and declared rough_route_boundary/time_out are separate. Boundary/timeout never relabelled as falls. No cross-reset stitching.
denominator_policy.technical_incompleteness: Capacity error, retention-limited producer, missing ticks, unknown reset, missing fields or unvalidated coordinate point invalidate the evidence scope; do not prune bad rows and publish a rate.
